name: Blocks for logarithms, multiplication, factors, and primes: The Logprimus

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a long, flat logarithmic ruler designed as an educational tool. It consists of a thin rectangular base plate with a recessed channel running along its length. One edge of this channel features a series of vertical tick marks spaced logarithmically, with every tenth mark being taller for easy visual reference.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric educational ruler in OpenSCAD with logarithmic markings. The ruler should have a flat rectangular base with a recessed channel, and customizable tick marks spaced according to logarithmic values up to a user-defined high mark.
captions.factory: The ruler is constructed using a difference() operation. A base plate is created using a main cube, and a slightly smaller, shallow cube is subtracted from it to form the recessed channel. A for-loop iterates from 2 to 'high_mark', calculating logarithmic positions using the 'log()' function. At each position, thin cubes are subtracted to form the tick marks, with a modulo condition ('n % 10 == 0') making every tenth mark longer.
